The concept in a nutshell
There are over 100 acute care hospitals in Switzerland. 
Not all hospitals offer the same treatments, the 
same quality or the same costs. The differences can 
be statistically mapped with data from several years.
Features of treatment quality for a given hospital are, 
for example:
–	 the number of cases treated
– 	the wound infection rate
– 	the mortality rate
– 	patient satisfaction
These and other features are collected annually 
throughout Switzerland for each hospital in a variety 
of diagnoses by the Swiss Federal Office of Public 
Health (BAG/OFSP/UFSP/FOHP) and the National 
Association for Quality Development in Hospitals and 
Clinics (ANQ). The data is publicly available.
On behalf of CONCORDIA, the institute B,S,S. Eco­
nomic Consultants in Basel evaluates these quality 
characteristics along with the length of stay and the 
costs of the benefits (basic and supplementary 
insurance), using anonymised data from several years, 
according to statistical quality criteria. Even though
the assessment takes costs into account, it is always 
the quality of care that determines the outcome.
This results in an overall assessment of all Swiss acute 
care hospitals for selected treatments in more than 
thirty diagnoses.
What does this mean for you?
Is a non-emergency inpatient hospital stay 
foreseen for you? Would you like to know which 
hospitals in Switzerland are particularly suitable 
for your treatment? 
We would be pleased, during a personal consultation, 
to present our hospital assessment in the following 
areas of expertise:
–	 Musculo-skeletal system and connective tissue: 
hip, knee, shoulder, spine, rheumatic diseases
– 	Cardiovascular system: arterial and venous 
diseases, chronic heart failure
– 	Nervous system: brain tumours
–	 Hormone-related metabolic disorders: thyroid 
gland, parathyroid glands including tumours
– 	Respiratory organs: lung tumours
– 	Digestive organs: oesophagus, stomach, 
duodenum, large and small intestine, rectum,
pancreas, liver, spleen including tumours
– 	Sensory organs: cataract, glaucoma, nose, 
paranasal sinus
– 	Women’s health: birth with/without caesarean, 
breast, uterus, ovaries including tumours
– 	Men’s health: prostate including tumours
This consultation will provide you with all the 
necessary information to choose a suitable hospital 
for your treatment.
